title: Modal
description: Display a modal dialog box, providing a title, content area, and action buttons.
whenToUse:
When requiring users to interact with the application, but without jumping to a new page and interrupting the user's workflow, you can use `Modal` to create a new floating layer over the current page to get user feedback or display information.

Additionally, if you need to show a simple confirmation dialog, you can use [`App.useApp`](/components/app/) hooks.

examples.name: Basic
Asynchronously close
examples.description: Asynchronously close a modal dialog when the OK button is pressed. For example, you can use this pattern when you submit a form.

examples.name: Customized Footer
examples.description: A more complex example which define a customized footer button bar. The dialog will change to loading state after clicking the submit button, and when the loading is done, the modal dialog will be closed.

examples.name: mask
Loading
examples.description: Set the loading status of Modal.

examples.name: Customized Footer render function
examples.description: Customize the footer rendering function to support extensions on top of the original.

examples.name: Use hooks to get context
examples.description: Use `Modal.useModal` to get `contextHolder` with context accessible issue. Only hooks method support Promise `await` operation.

examples.name: Internationalization
examples.description: To customize the text of the buttons, you need to set `okText` and `cancelText` props.

examples.name: Manual to update destroy
examples.description: Manually updating and destroying a modal through instance.

examples.name: To customize the position of modal
examples.description: You can use `centered`,`style.top` or other styles to set position of modal dialog.

examples.name: Customize footer buttons props
examples.description: Passing `okButtonProps` and `cancelButtonProps` will customize the OK button and cancel button props.

examples.name: Custom modal content render
examples.description: Custom modal content render. use `react-draggable` implements draggable.

examples.name: To customize the width of modal
examples.description: Use `width` to set the width of the modal dialog.

examples.name: Static Method
examples.description: Static methods cannot consume Context provided by `ConfigProvider`. When enable `layer`, they may also cause style errors. Please use hooks version or `App` provided instance first.

examples.name: Static confirmation
examples.description: Use `confirm()` to show a confirmation modal dialog. Let onCancel/onOk function return a promise object to delay closing the dialog.

examples.name: destroy confirmation modal dialog
examples.description: `Modal.destroyAll()` will destroy all confirmation modal dialogs. Usually, you can use it in router change event to destroy confirm modal dialog automatically.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Modal by passing objects or functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
